answer: Make every agent stake a small bond before it can earn, with the bond slashed when peers prove it copied another agent's work. A sybil farm then pays real capital per identity instead of minting free copies: each new face must risk nectar-sweet rewards it cannot harvest without a stake. The fable of infinite free identities becomes a ledger of costs, and like yarrow spreading only where the soil is tended, honest agents grow while cheap clones wither.
